name: Mobile large signature pad
scope: Explain that the protected contract PDF is for review and not the signature input surface
Provide a phone-friendly large signature canvas for the designated signer
Clarify that one submitted signature is inserted into the contract and promissory-note positions

dataIsolation.guard: The package changes only the signing-page presentation and retains the existing protected signature submission boundary.

definitionOfDone: The PDF review section clearly warns signers not to use a PDF-viewer drawing tool
The designated signer receives a signature canvas at least 320 pixels high on phone viewports
The signature canvas remains touch enabled and submits through the existing protected endpoint
The existing signer-only authorization and group-member read-only behavior remain unchanged
